definitions.explanation: Oriented toward the south, especially of rooms, buildings, or windows, which receive the most sunlight in Japan.

examples.japanese: この{部屋|へや}は{南向|みなみむ}きだ。
{南向|みなみむ}きのマンションは{人気|にんき}がある。
{南向|みなみむ}きの{窓|まど}から{日差|ひざ}しがたっぷり{入|はい}るので、{冬|ふゆ}でも{暖|あたた}かい。
examples.english: Plenty of sunlight comes through the south-facing window, so it's warm even in winter.

notes:
A compound of {南|みなみ} (south) and {向|む}き (facing, orientation). In Japanese real estate, {南向|みなみむ}き is highly valued because south-facing rooms get the most sunlight throughout the day. It is one of the most important criteria when choosing an apartment or house in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南向|みなみむ}きの{部屋|へや}: south-facing room
- {南向|みなみむ}きの{窓|まど}: south-facing window
- {南向|みなみむ}きの{物件|ぶっけん}: south-facing property
- {南向|みなみむ}きのバルコニー: south-facing balcony

RELATED TERMS:
- {北向|きたむ}き: north-facing — least desirable for sunlight
- {東向|ひがしむ}き: east-facing — gets morning sun
- {西向|にしむ}き: west-facing — gets afternoon sun
- {日当|ひあ}たり: sun exposure — a key factor in Japanese housing
